description: On a damaging contact move, one 20% activation attempt per move (including multi-hit); if activated, choose burn, sleep, poison or paralysis uniformly. No reroll on immunity or already-statused target.
Mega Evolution starts hail/snow; at the end of each turn with active hail/snow, holder gains +1 Sp. Atk and +1 Sp. Def, capped at +6 each. Weather change stops further boosts.
Possible follow-up strike from infernal second head after a damaging contact attack; exact proc and mechanics not finalized.
Possible prevention of newly inflicted major statuses for the user and partner; singles/doubles balance not finalized.
